articles.summary: KFAR SAVA, Israel - March 18, 2026 - Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC), a leading provider of networking and data infrastructure solutions, today announced that management will participate in the 38th Annual Roth Conference being held March 22-24, 2026, at the Ritz-Carlton Laguna Niguel in Dana Point, California.

articles.summary: KFAR SAVA, Israel, March 31, 2026 - Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC), an industry-leading provider of high-performance server/appliances networking solutions, announced today that it will be releasing its first quarter 2026 results on Thursday, April 30, 2026.
